description: externalScopeSatisfied(requiredScope, scopes, alwaysEnforceScope) — packages/api/src/access/external-scope.ts (Sprint 1.6). Empty scopes = wildcard by default; alwaysEnforceScope overrides that so the scope must be explicitly present (vendor writes). Ported to Tims.Domain.Access.ExternalScope.ExternalScopeSatisfied. requiredScope null models the TS `undefined`.

cases.name: empty scopes, not enforced -> wildcard satisfied
empty scopes, ENFORCED -> denied (1.6: role grant cannot silently widen a key)
required scope present among several, enforced -> satisfied
required scope present but enforced with only that scope -> satisfied
no required scope even when enforced -> satisfied (requiredScope short-circuits first)
